2117835682702110999.en_summary: X and Elon rhetoric is apocalyptic on Democrats winning, but AI is a bipartisan national security priority. $NVDA historic rally and AI buildout acceleration occurred under Biden. No market-wide doomsday even with Democratic governor; some headwinds for developers but incentives shift to areas like solar manufacturing. Bitcoin and Ethereum performed better under Gensler regulation. Markets move on after worst-case fears such as helium disruption affecting Samsung, $TSM and the memory trade.
2117835682702110999.zh_summary: X上及Elon對民主黨獲勝的言論偏向末日，但AI是兩黨國家安全優先事項。NVDA歷史性反彈及AI建設加速發生在拜登政府期間。即使有民主黨州長也不會有市場全面末日；個別開發者有阻力，但激勵轉向太陽能製造等領域。比特幣與以太坊在Gensler監管下表現更好。市場在幾週後從最壞情況如氦氣中斷影響三星、TSM及記憶體交易中恢復。

2117832474348990972.en_summary: If $QQQ closed the year at current level, it would be the smallest up year since 2016. Since Trump became President there have been 4 separate 10%+ declines in the Qs. Still a bull market but challenging lately.
2117832474348990972.zh_summary: 如果QQQ以目前水準收盤年度，將是自2016年以來最小的上漲年。自特朗普就任總統以來，納指有4次單獨超過10%的下跌。仍是牛市，但近期具挑戰性。

2117828348256629066.en_summary: $FISV stock clocks best day in over 2 decades after strong Q3 results. Goldman Sachs raises price target to $61 from $56 and maintains Neutral. Baird raises target to $70 from $62 and maintains Outperform. Stock soared more than 12%.
2117828348256629066.zh_summary: FISV股票在強勁Q3業績後錄得超過20年最佳單日漲幅。高盛將目標價從56美元上調至61美元並維持中性評級。Baird將目標價從62美元上調至70美元並維持跑贏評級。股價大漲超過12%。

ticker_notes.FISV: GS PT $61 Neutral, Baird PT $70 Outperform after Q3 beat
